about: The suggested minimum base price for each chain, in GRT per 30 days. These are the figures
shown commented out under [dips.min_grt_per_30_days] in maximal-config-example.toml, and a
test in this crate fails if the 2 disagree.
Dipper, the service that offers indexing agreements to indexers, reads this file from the
main branch while it runs and sets its price ceilings from it: by default it leaves out of
selection any indexer whose base price is more than a fixed multiple of the figure for the
chain. So a change merged here changes what dipper will accept within hours of merging.
Dipper keeps the figures it had, and raises an alert, when a version of this file drops a
chain, moves a figure by more than 10 times, or holds anything but positive numbers.
